question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> be a plane passing through the points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>,</mo><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo><mo>.</mo></math> Let a vector <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>α</mi><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>γ</mi><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> be such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is parallel to the plane <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math>, perpendicular to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>·</mo><mo>(</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover><mi>k</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi>α</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>γ</mi><msup><mo>)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></math> equals______.

solution.text:
Equation of plane is

x-1y-0z-11-121-11-00-11+2=0

⇒x-1yz-10201-13=0

⇒x-16-y0+z-1-2=0

⇒3x-1-z+1=0

⇒3x-z-2=0

Since, a→=αi^+βj^+γk^ is parallel to 3x-z-2=0, therefore normal vector of plane is perpendicular to a→, hence

⇒3α-γ=0  ...1

Now,

a→⊥i˙+2j^+3k^

⇒α+2β+3γ=0   ...2

And,

a→·(i^+j^+2k^)=0

⇒α+β+2γ=2    ...3

On solving 1, 2 & 3, we get

α=1, β=-5, γ=3

So, α-β+γ2=81
